data.body:
[P2] Isolate deferred export failures from parent scope setup

This drain runs inside `on_user_function_start`, before `_attach_context`. If a callback completed during suspension and its processor raises when replay registers the parent, `_render_operation_end` re-raises because `_finalization` is still `None`. Core contains the exception and executes the parent's body without attaching its OTel context, so user-created spans and correlated logs use the enclosing context. Later completion retries cannot repair that parentage. Contain ordinary failures per pending completion, retain their retry state, and allow parent setup to finish. Add a replay regression with a processor that fails once; Execution view's registration drain needs the same protection.
